paragraphs: Mentioned in Sotah 41b, expounding that it is permitted to flatter the wicked in this world, as it is said, etc.[^1][^2]

notes.text: The frozen בע״הן is retained in Hebrew; the named William Davidson vocalized Sotah 41b passage explicitly has בעולם הזה, in this world, and Rabbi Yehudah bar Maarava. This supports the contextual phrase and exact full-title expansion without deciding whether the anomalous final letter arose in print or transcription. The named text also supplies an alternative attribution to Rabbi Shimon ben Pazi; Hyman’s shorter notice is not expanded to include it.

מא: gives Sotah 41b. The permitted-to-flatter teaching is reported as the source’s statement, not contemporary advice. As-it-is-said etc. retains Hyman’s elided proof-text rather than importing the named passage’s full verse.
